quotes.text: Through web crawling, we collected 427 disease–symptom pairs, of which 194 corresponded to the nine internal medicine departments targeted in this study.

parsed.rationale: The source (NHS Inform, Scotland, via web crawling) is named with its platform, but no snapshot or crawl date, version, or route from each task to a source record is given. Hospital, physician and patient records are synthetic, so only the disease-symptom source needs tracing.
